description:
Raso Gravel Wide launches a new era of adventure at pace. Informed by the demands of modern off-road racing, Raso Gravel Wide leads with extreme for the fastest known time to the farthest lines on the map.

Set your sights higher with a gravel bike equipped to ride to the challenge of the world’s gnarliest trails. Raso Gravel Wide accepts up to 55mm (2.2”) on a 700c wheel, depending on your preferences, with 1x compatibility and space for up to a 52t chainring, in line and inspired by the demands of the global gravel racing and adventure community.

The Raso TC frame utilizes a specialized Tri-Composite Carbon Fiber augmented with metallic filaments. This material, derived from resistant components in the automotive sector , is engineered for superior riding comfort and robustness. Its key technical advantages are an excellent impact resistance and a high capacity for vibration damping , which minimizes localized mechanical stresses while retaining a unique aesthetic.

The Forged Carbon process is inspired by luxury automotive and aerospace industries. Unlike traditional continuous carbon fiber, this composite uses fibers that are cut and reduced into small fragments. This process, known as molding, allows for exceptional quality repeatability and remarkable freedom in geometry and design. The material is applied by hand for visual appeal and to reinforce tubes or joints , and its post-processing yields a striking, almost three-dimensional effect.

With UDH compatibility at its core, we’re proud to present Raso Gravel with industry-accepted, future-proof technologies that greatly enhance your riding experience and confidence over rockier passes.

Wider tires and the demands of off-road riding led us to design a new front fork for Raso Gravel Wide. Vibration-dampening, torsionally stiff and visually stunning, the new fork inherits the well-balanced lines of our road silhouette, with the added resilience and compliance that trail conditions demand.

Like every Sarto, Raso Gravel Wide is a product of in-house design and manufacture. From the first fibre, we work under one roof, forming, shaping, bonding and painting everything here at our HQ in Venice, Italy. Stock is not in our vocabulary. We create at the cutting edge of custom, crafting frame compositions, geometries and specifications for every rider in the ultimate realisation of bespoke, handmade precision.

frame.material_detail: M46JC/CN80/T800 carbon, Tri-Composite Carbon Fiber outer layer
